method: METADATA (primary) + HEADER-VERIFIED (independent) + MSE-BAND (independent). (1) PRIMARY: tier_bitmap.json field 'k' is a 256-entry list of 3|4 per layer for layers 3..78; config.json declares bits_per_expert='tier_bitmap.json:k'. (2) INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION: safetensors headers fetched by HTTP ranged read for layers 0,3,4,5,30,77,78 at revision ae68c659 -- every expert's 12 trellis tensors have last dim 16*K (48=K3, 64=K4) and all 12 agree within an expert; per-layer counts matched tier_bitmap EXACTLY (L3 206/50, L4 148/108, L5 148/108, L30 148/108, L77 148/108, L78 256/0). Prior session independently verified L3/L30/L78 at the same pin. (3) SECOND INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION: tier_bitmap's expert_rel_rt_mse forms two perfectly separable bands (K4 0.004539-0.008291, K3 0.017867-0.031967) matching this project's measured epsilon ladder (K3 0.0231 / K4 0.0060), and K4set == lowest-mse-N in 75/75 layers -- i.e. rel_rt_mse is the ACHIEVED roundtrip error at the shipped K, an output consistent with the declared map. (4) Per-expert unit byte sizes reproduce the header expert-per-rank totals EXACTLY (e.g. L4: 148*3,542,028 + 108*4,721,676 = 1,034,161,152 B == header sum).
confidence: HIGH - exact, complete, per-expert identity for all 19,456 experts across all 76 MoE layers. Not partial. Three independent lines of evidence agree with zero discrepancies.
caveats: The artifact records WHICH experts are at K4, not WHY. The selection signal used by the human is not published; the README attributes it to 'coding expert alignments' inherited from the 3.25bpw Coder build and madeby561/GLM-5.2-MXFP8-NVFP4-NF3-Hybrid. The demo therefore rediscovers an OUTCOME against a blind target, not a documented algorithm.
expert_rel_rt_mse must NOT be used as the reference's selection criterion: it is the post-hoc achieved error at the assigned K.
Layer 78 (MTP draft) is uniformly K3 in this build and carries no K4 promotions; exclude it from overlap scoring or it contributes a degenerate empty set.
Layer 3 has a different budget (50 K4) from layers 4..77 (108 K4); score it separately or per-layer.
